original_query: Which part of appendixes shows the Signs/symptoms of Diarrhoea and crampy pain?

confirmed.answer_text: Retro/paraleal location of the appendix is associated with signs/symptoms including diarrhoea and crampy pain.
confirmed.summary: The page outlines atypical presentations of appendicitis by listing different locations of the appendix and the corresponding signs and symptoms. It includes locations such as McBurney's point, retro/paracaecal, retro/paraleal, and pelvic, each with specific clinical presentations.
key_facts: Retro/paraleal location of the appendix is associated with signs/symptoms including diarrhoea and crampy pain.
